methodology.universe: We cover active, regular-plan, growth-option mutual fund schemes across equity, hybrid and solution-oriented categories. Index funds, ETFs, fund-of-funds, passive and arbitrage funds are excluded, since they aren't trying to pick stocks.
methodology.stock_picking_history: A fund is rated on stock-picking skill only once it has at least 12 months of disclosed monthly holdings. Until then it's scored on returns-based measures alone and labelled accordingly, so a few lucky months on a new fund can't masquerade as skill.
